component_identity_contract: Return stance_components as one array. Each array item is one atomic component object whose object kind, object interpretation, expression kind, and one source alias belong together. Never return parallel component columns and never combine two source aliases in one component.
endpoint_definition: Apply role_boundary_contract to the visible early or later endpoint.
expression_interpretation_contract: Classify expression from the source speaker's relationship to that component, not from the role name or the fact that a situation was mentioned. Use reported_without_endorsement only when the speaker attributes a position, proposal, or assessment to someone else without adopting it. The speaker's own excitement or desire is preference_or_desire; own worry that pushes against an option is counterpressure; 'cannot tell', 'not resolved', or equivalent open judgment is uncertain_or_undecided; leaning, proposals, commitments, and conditional willingness retain their specific force. Do not upgrade or flatten modal strength.

focal_region.annotated_sentence_text:
[Turn 1 USER]
e001	I oversee a municipal housing authority with twelve aging apartment buildings.
e002	An energy-services company has offered to finance heat pumps, insulation, and smart controls in exchange for a fifteen-year share of measured energy savings.
e003	I want lower bills and healthier buildings, but I am worried that a long performance contract will transfer practical control of residents' homes to a vendor.
e004	I cannot tell whether my resistance protects tenants or protects an old maintenance culture that has already failed them.
[Turn 1 ASSISTANT]
e005	The offer combines resident comfort, energy cost, building health, capital scarcity, vendor control, data collection, and long-term dependence.
e006	Separate physical improvements from the measurement and control regime used to finance them.
e007	Also distinguish formal tenant choice from the practical consequences of living in a collectively managed building.
[Turn 7 USER]
e031	I am leaning toward the two-building, eighteen-month pilot with manual controls, opt-in sensors, ninety-day raw-data deletion, tenant-approved notices, no housing decisions from sensor data, independent verification, complaint staffing, and public operational reporting.
e032	I will accept building-wide optimization only if comfort minimums, override response times, outage protections, and resident appeal rights are contractual.
e033	Before signing, I will set bill, comfort, complaint, override, outage, deletion, and intervention thresholds.
e034	I will approve the pilot only if the city has a capped path to equipment ownership and exit, but I still have not resolved whether sensor opt-out is meaningful when every resident remains subject to a model trained on collective building behavior.
[Turn 7 ASSISTANT]
e035	The current position is a bounded retrofit and operations trial rather than a fifteen-year transfer of building control.
e036	Its scope, controls, data, housing-use, verification, appeal, threshold, ownership, and exit conditions constrain several dependencies.
e037	The unresolved issue is whether individual choice is overstated when building-level optimization remains collective.
e038	If the pilot ends, installed equipment, maintenance routines, resident expectations, and the authority's dependence on vendor-designed operating models may not return to their prior state.

question: What starting position, attraction, hesitation, or undecided stance is visible before the current position? Do not infer a start that the source does not show.
record_identity_contract: One record is one coherent position thread within the assigned role. Gather every material visible alias for that thread into evidence_ids. Put each distinct object or expression into a separate aligned component index inside that same record. Do not create one record per alias, sentence, object, or component. Use a second record only for a genuinely separate concurrent position thread about a different subject.
role_boundary_contract: Extract the earliest visible working position: the user's own attractions, preferences, hesitations, assessments, and unresolved stance at the first endpoint. Context about an external offer or another person's position is evidence only when it helps express the user's own starting stance; do not mistake mere situation description for endorsement.
source_coverage_contract: Review every focal alias before returning. A valid empty response is allowed only after checking both user and assistant evidence for the assigned role. Preserve later minority qualifications and counterpressure even when the current action is already clear.
